sharedReads.name: Canva
sharedReads.purpose: Editable social graphics, presentations and approved brand templates
sharedReads.scope: design:meta:read; template/content scopes only for later approved work
sharedReads.nextStep: Canva chat read verified on 13 October 2026. Configure and verify direct Office authentication and its scoped worker route next; no Brand Kit is selected.

sharedReads.name: Mailchimp
sharedReads.purpose: Newsletter drafts, email performance and approved audience workflows
sharedReads.scope: Account health first; exact audience and send permission later
sharedReads.nextStep: Authorize the shared Mailchimp account securely; first verify the API health read, then prepare drafts and reports before any sending.

sharedReads.name: Google Drive
sharedReads.purpose: Source files, Docs, Sheets, briefs and approved asset references
sharedReads.scope: Selected file access preferred; read scopes matched to the intended operation
sharedReads.nextStep: Verify shared Drive access, then choose source folders explicitly and preserve their permissions. No automatic whole-drive ingestion.

sharedReads.name: Google Calendar
sharedReads.purpose: Real availability and approved campaign or meeting timelines
sharedReads.nextStep: Verify the calendar-list read, then choose calendars. Event creation and recurring Office jobs remain separate.

sharedReads.name: Gmail
sharedReads.purpose: Email context and reviewed response drafts
sharedReads.scope: gmail.metadata for capability check; content/draft/send permissions separately
sharedReads.nextStep: Verify mailbox capability without returning message content. Scoped email context and draft creation follow; sending stays gated.

sharedReads.name: Google Analytics
sharedReads.purpose: Traffic, conversion events and campaign outcome reporting
sharedReads.nextStep: Verify account access, bind the right property later, then check conversion instrumentation and attribution. An account read is not a working report.

sharedReads.name: Google Search Console
sharedReads.purpose: Search queries, visibility, clicks and content opportunities
sharedReads.nextStep: Verify the account read, then choose the correct verified property. Search data does not prove revenue or conversion tracking.

features.name: Connection evidence
features.nextStep: Provider registration → account read → worker route → scoped client binding → recorded operation. Keep every stage visible.

features.name: Versioned brand memory
features.nextStep: Use voice, offer, visual rules and approved source references; add campaign outcomes only after verified measurement.

features.name: Campaign outcome loop
features.nextStep: Join approved asset version, external publication receipt and campaign metrics. Distinguish correlation from causal revenue attribution.

features.name: Searchable Brain and source graph
features.nextStep: Search notes, assets, lessons and their task/source links; a graph should open the actual referenced evidence.

features.name: Department setup interview
features.nextStep: Collect purpose, common job, success criteria, boundaries and tools; save draft rules and preview them before approval.

features.name: Correction-to-lesson workflow
features.nextStep: Propose one-off versus standing correction with scope and evidence. Keep reviewed lessons reversible and versioned.

features.name: Revision from saved pieces
features.nextStep: Revise the exact reviewed deliverable using retained dependency outputs; do not silently rerun a full team.

features.name: Work calendar and routines
features.nextStep: A calendar can show saved/scheduled work. Future execution needs explicit authorization, duplicate prevention, missed-run policy and a stop control. No timer is enabled.

features.name: Subscription-aware queue
features.nextStep: Show provider availability/quota evidence and defer work when limited; preserve monthly subscriptions and no paid API fallback.

features.name: Browser tasks
features.nextStep: Separate browser profiles or serialized sessions; never grant all agents unrestricted control of the owner’s live browser.
